user.title: Soil moisture indicator
user.description: Pick an existing soil moisture sensor and the plant type growing in that soil. The integration adds a moisture prediction sensor and a sensor for the optimal moisture of that plant type.

data_description.source_entity: Sensor that reports the current soil moisture in %.
data_description.sensor_type: Capacitive sensors measure the dielectric constant, resistive sensors the conductivity. A resistive sensor reports a few percentage points wetter for the same soil, so the optimal range is set lower.
data_description.weather_entity: Optional weather entity for the weather based 7 day forecast. Leave empty to use the only weather entity of your instance.
data_description.name: Optional name, for example 'Tomatoes greenhouse'.
data_description.container_volume: Substrate volume in litres, used to calculate the watering amount. 0 disables the amount sensor.

abort.already_configured: This sensor is already configured for this plant type.

data_description.sensor_type: Capacitive or resistive. A resistive sensor reports wetter for the same soil, so the optimal range is 8 percentage points lower.
data_description.prediction_horizon: How many hours into the future the prediction sensor looks.
data_description.history_hours: How much past data is used to fit the moisture trend.
data_description.weather_entity: Used for the weather based 7 day forecast. Empty means the only weather entity of your instance.
data_description.container_volume: Substrate volume in litres, used to calculate the watering amount. 0 disables the amount sensor.
